### SUMMARY
Applied all CSS fixes to `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` for the three Admin Form Management page issues. The file now has a select truncation rule to prevent the Form Type dropdown from overflowing, horizontal scrolling and a `min-width: 700px` on the table to keep Status and Submitter columns in view, increased cell padding for breathing room, and two responsive breakpoints (768px and 480px) for mobile. Braces are balanced (90 opening, 90 closing).

### EVIDENCE
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — final file read back in full; all edits present and syntactically valid.
- Shell command `python3 -c "count braces..."` exit code 0; output: `Opening braces: 90`, `Closing braces: 90`, `✓ Braces are BALANCED`.
- Each `edit_file` call returned a successful unified diff.

### CHANGES
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Added `.afm-filter-group select.afm-filter-select` rule (max-width: 100%, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis, white-space nowrap, min-width: 0) to truncate the form-type select dropdown.
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Updated `.afm-table-wrapper` with `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` and `width: 100%` to enable smooth horizontal scrolling.
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Added `min-width: 700px` to `.afm-table` to prevent column squishing.
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Changed `.afm-table th` padding from `1rem 1.25rem` to `1rem 1.5rem` and `.afm-table td` padding from `1rem 1.25rem` to `1.1rem 1.5rem` for more breathing room.
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Updated 768px `@media` block: th/td padding changed from `0.75rem` to `0.85rem 1rem` with added `font-size: 0.85rem`.
- `FrontEnd/src/pages/AdminFormManagement.css` — Added new `@media (max-width: 480px)` breakpoint with mobile-friendly overrides for content padding, title size, filter panel, select/input font-size, table cells, status badges, pagination layout, and page buttons.

### RISKS
- **Select truncation is partial on `<select>` elements** — The `text-overflow: ellipsis` property applied to the `<select>` element itself works inconsistently across browsers because the native dropdown arrow and OS-rendered options cannot be truncated within the select widget. A more robust fix would involve a custom dropdown component (or truncating option text in JavaScript). Mitigated somewhat by `max-width: 100%` which at least prevents the select from blowing out the filter panel width.
- **`-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` is deprecated** — This property is non-standard and removed from recent iOS Safari. It does no harm (ignored when unsupported) but provides no benefit on modern browsers. Could be removed in a future cleanup.

### BLOCKERS
None.
